subject: Request for Amendment to Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference.

Please note that we have found discrepancies that require your immediate attention and amendment.

Specifically, the Consignee currently reads "UAB NOVAKOPA" on the draft Bill of Lading, whereas the Shipping Instruction states "EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC".

Additionally, the Notify Party is listed as "UAB NOVAKOPA" on the draft Bill of Lading, but the Shipping Instruction specifies "EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC".

Kindly update the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction in all respects.

Shipping Operations
